therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis inhibition and tumor cell proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: extensive-stage small cell lung cancer patients

safety_signals: grade 3-4-5 treatment related toxicities in 14/18 patients
